title: Market size and strategic interaction in pharmaceutical price regulation
title_zh: 药品价格监管中的市场规模与策略互动
title_primary: 药品价格监管中的市场规模与策略互动
title_secondary: Market size and strategic interaction in pharmaceutical price regulation
authors: Simona Gambaⓡ, Paolo Pertileⓡ, Martin Forsterⓡ
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present a model of optimal regulation in the presence of spillover effects and asymmetric countries, and we use it to study strategic interaction among countries in pharmaceutical price regulation, where the spillovers result from innovation in drug development. Regulators' pricing decisions affect welfare both directly and indirectly, via firms' R&D policies. We characterize two types of equilibrium, depending on whether countries price at, or above, the minimum level the industry is willing to accept to serve the market. The combination of these two equilibria may imply a U‐shaped relationship between countries' pharmaceutical prices and relative market size. Using data for 83 cancer drugs across 23 OECD countries, our empirical analysis supports this hypothesis, with results being robust to correcting for the impact of confidential price discounts and a range of different model specifications. Our findings contribute to the academic debate about the relationship between prices and market size, as well as the policy debate about using supranational procurement policies to lower prices. In particular, we show that joint procurement can lower or raise prices according to the sizes of the domestic markets that join to create a single purchasing authority.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在存在溢出效应与不对称国家情形下的最优规制模型，并以此研究各国在药品价格规制中的策略互动，其中溢出效应源于药物研发领域的创新。监管者的定价决策通过企业的研发政策，既直接又间接地影响社会福利。我们刻画了两种均衡类型，其区分依据在于各国定价是处于行业愿意接受以服务市场的最低水平，还是高于该水平。这两种均衡的组合可能意味着国家间药品价格与相对市场规模之间存在U型关系。利用涵盖23个OECD国家、83种抗癌药物的数据，我们的实证分析支持了这一假设，且结果在考虑保密性价格折扣的影响及多种不同模型设定后依然稳健。我们的发现为关于价格与市场规模关系的学术辩论，以及关于运用超国家集中采购政策以降低价格的政策讨论均作出了贡献。特别是，我们表明，联合采购根据组成单一采购机构的各国内部市场规模的不同，既可能降低也可能抬高价格。

title: Cycling cities: Mode choice, car congestion, and urban structure
title_zh: 骑行城市：出行方式选择、汽车拥堵与城市结构
title_primary: 骑行城市：出行方式选择、汽车拥堵与城市结构
title_secondary: Cycling cities: Mode choice, car congestion, and urban structure
authors: Tijl Hendrich, Hans R.A. Koster, Nicole Loumeau, Jos van Ommeren
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Cycling as a mode of commuting has gained popularity in cities worldwide. This study examines the impact of cycling on the urban spatial structure and welfare through the development of a quantitative spatial equilibrium model that incorporates mode choice and car congestion. We apply this model to the Netherlands, which is known for its extensive cycling infrastructure. Eliminating cycling increases commuting times and distances by 15% and 30%, exacerbates car congestion, and results in a significant reduction in worker welfare. We also show that removing dedicated cycleways leads to similar, although less pronounced, changes in the spatial economy.
abstract_zh: 骑行作为一种通勤方式在全球城市中日益普及。本研究通过构建一个纳入出行方式选择与汽车拥堵的量化空间均衡模型，探讨骑行对城市空间结构与福利的影响。我们将该模型应用于以广泛骑行基础设施著称的荷兰。消除骑行会使通勤时间与距离分别增加15%和30%，加剧汽车拥堵，并导致劳动者福利显著下降。我们还表明，移除专用自行车道会引发类似但程度较轻的空间经济变化。

title: The complementary role of information and contraceptive access in teen pregnancy
title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用
title_primary: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用
title_secondary: The complementary role of information and contraceptive access in teen pregnancy
authors: Sevin Kaytan, Stwarth Piedra-Bonilla, Tom Zohar
official: 来源期次 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa-Rican initiative that combined two pillars: free access to long-acting-reversible contraceptives; and a tailored information campaign to raise awareness and correct for baseline misperceptions. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access: districts exposed to both pillars experience substantially larger reductions than those with contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the initiative shifted the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misperceptions on sexual health.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供项目的有效性。我们研究了一项哥斯达黎加倡议，该倡议结合了两大支柱：免费获取长效可逆避孕药具；以及一项量身定制的信息宣传活动，旨在提高认识并纠正基线误解。利用行政数据和该倡议的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。我们表明信息与获取途径相辅相成：同时接触两大支柱的地区，其生育率下降幅度显著大于仅能获取避孕药具的地区。通过关于性行为的调查，我们显示该倡议将信息来源从个人社交网络转向医疗保健专业人员，从而修正了关于性健康的误解。

title: Who Values Democracy?
title_zh: 谁重视民主？
title_primary: 谁重视民主？
title_secondary: Who Values Democracy?
authors: Max Miller
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I show democratizations have a large, negative impact on asset valuations driven by a rise in redistribution risk. Across 90 countries over 200 years, risk premia are substantially elevated in democratizations, similar in magnitude to financial crises. Using a shift in Catholic church doctrine in support of democracy, I provide causal evidence that democratizations increase risk premia. Successful democratizations lead to substantial redistribution: the size of the public sector grows, income inequality falls, and the labor share of income rises. A model of asset prices and political regimes in which wealthy asset market participants face redistribution risk in democratizations can quantitatively explain these effects. The model also explains the negligible asset pricing response to autocratizations. Neither an increase in macroeconomic risk nor generic political risk can explain the results.
abstract_zh: 我证明民主化对资产估值具有显著的负面影响，这一影响源于再分配风险的上升。在跨越200年、涵盖90个国家的研究中，民主化期间的风险溢价显著升高，其幅度与金融危机相当。利用天主教会教义转向支持民主这一变化，我提供了因果证据表明民主化提升了风险溢价。成功的民主化导致实质性再分配：公共部门规模扩大，收入不平等程度下降，劳动收入份额上升。一个将资产价格与政治体制相结合的模型，其中富裕的资产市场参与者面临民主化中的再分配风险，能够定量解释这些效应。该模型同样解释了为何威权化对资产定价的影响微乎其微。宏观经济风险的增加或一般性政治风险均无法解释这些结果。

title: DP20886 Divine Catalysts: Religion and Portfolio Choices
title_zh: 神圣催化剂：宗教与投资组合选择
title_primary: 神圣催化剂：宗教与投资组合选择
title_secondary: DP20886 Divine Catalysts: Religion and Portfolio Choices
authors: Maxime Bonelli, Pulak Ghosh, Lakshmi Naaraayanan, Purnoor Tak
official: 官方在线 2025-12-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines how religion influences equity investment and portfolio diversification. We exploit trading sessions held during a major religious festival in India that emphasizes new beginnings and long-term prosperity to examine how religiously framed cues affect individual investor behavior. Individuals whose religion is associated with the festival invest substantially more during these sessions and buy new stocks. Consistent with the emphasis on long-term prosperity, purchases are concentrated in stocks of large, mature, and low-volatility firms, and do not exhibit lottery-like characteristics. These investments are held longer than other portfolio positions and result in persistent increases in portfolio size and diversification. In addition, these purchases represent a larger financial commitment for lower-income individuals and smaller accounts, who subsequently benefit from increased equity exposure. Our findings highlight that religion can nudge individuals towards long-term investments and have implications for wealth accumulation.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了宗教如何影响股权投资与投资组合多样化。我们利用印度一个强调新开端与长期繁荣的重大宗教节日期间举行的交易时段，来研究宗教框架下的提示如何影响个人投资者行为。与该节日相关的宗教信徒在这些时段内投资显著增加，并购买新股票。与强调长期繁荣相一致，这些购买集中于大型、成熟且低波动性的公司股票，并不具有彩票式特征。这些投资持有时间比其他投资组合头寸更长，并导致投资组合规模和多样化的持续增长。此外，这些购买对低收入个人和小额账户构成了更大的财务承诺，他们随后从增加的股权敞口中受益。我们的研究结果强调，宗教可以引导个人进行长期投资，并对财富积累产生影响。

title: The Salience of Entrepreneurship: Evidence from Online Business
title_zh: 创业的显著性：来自在线商业的证据
title_primary: 创业的显著性：来自在线商业的证据
title_secondary: The Salience of Entrepreneurship: Evidence from Online Business
authors: Yi Huang, Chen Lin, Sibo Liu, Gustavo Manso
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the decision to become an entrepreneur in the context of online business. Using data on entrepreneurs from a large e-commerce marketplace in China, we find that individuals are more likely to start online businesses after observing the salient success of nearby stores. Leveraging the platform’s store rating system and detailed geographic information in rural China, we show that an upgrade in a local store’s rating leads to a significant increase in new store entries nearby. This effect diminishes with physical distance and intensifies with the salience of the upgrade. However, these entry decisions appear to be suboptimal; entrants driven by local upgrade events underperform in sales and are more likely to exit, especially during downturns in overall market conditions. Our findings are consistent with salience-based theories of decision making, in which individuals overweight highly visible local information. This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance. Funding: C. Lin acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Project 72192841] and the Research Grant Council of the Hong Kong SAR, China [Project T35-710/20-R]. S. Liu acknowledges financial support from the Research Grant Council of the Hong Kong SAR, China [Project 12503324]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04409 .
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在网络商业背景下成为创业者的决策。利用中国大型电子商务市场平台上的创业者数据，我们发现个体在观察到附近店铺的显著成功后，更有可能开始线上创业。借助平台的店铺评级系统及中国农村地区的详细地理信息，我们证明，当地一家店铺评级的提升会导致周边新店铺入驻数量显著增加。这一效应随物理距离的增大而减弱，并随评级提升的显著性增强而加剧。然而，这些入驻决策似乎并非最优；受当地评级提升事件驱动的入驻者在销售业绩上表现不佳，且更可能退出市场，尤其是在整体市场环境低迷时期。我们的发现与基于显著性的决策理论相符，即个体过度重视高可见度的本地信息。本文已被金融领域编辑Lin William Cong接受。资助：C. Lin感谢中国国家自然科学基金[项目72192841]及中国香港特别行政区研究资助局[项目T35-710/20-R]的财政支持。S. Liu感谢中国香港特别行政区研究资助局[项目12503324]的财政支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04409获取。

title: How early academic rank shapes high school choices and admissions
title_zh: 早期学术排名如何影响高中选择与录取
title_primary: 早期学术排名如何影响高中选择与录取
title_secondary: How early academic rank shapes high school choices and admissions
authors: Eunsik Chang, Maria Padilla-Romo, Cecilia Peluffo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Students with the same test score can have considerably different academic ranks depending on their school peers. Using data from the Mexico City metropolitan area, this column examines how differences relative academic ranks in elementary school affect later cognitive and noncognitive outcomes. Among students with similar third-grade scores, those with higher academic ranks performed better on their high school admission exams. The early ranks also shaped college aspirations and academic self-perceptions. Early academic ranks can be particularly consequential for students with fewer socioeconomic resources.
abstract_zh: 测试分数相同的学生，其学业排名可能因学校同伴不同而大相径庭。利用墨西哥城大都市区的数据，本文考察了小学阶段相对学业排名的差异如何影响后续的认知与非认知结果。在三年级成绩相近的学生中，学业排名较高者在高中入学考试中表现更佳。早期排名还塑造了大学志向与学业自我认知。对于社会经济资源较少的学生而言，早期学业排名的影响尤为显著。

title: Climate policies as a catalyst for green FDI
title_zh: 气候政策作为绿色外商直接投资的催化剂
title_primary: 气候政策作为绿色外商直接投资的催化剂
title_secondary: Climate policies as a catalyst for green FDI
authors: Samuel Pienknagura
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper assesses the role of climate policies as a catalyst of low carbon technologies deployment through foreign direct investment (FDI). Leveraging detailed cross-border project-level information, it identifies “green” FDI and finds that a higher number of active climate policies is associated with higher levels of green FDI inflows. Importantly, climate policies do not appear to be linked to lower levels of non-green projects, suggesting relatively small overall costs from the green transition. The paper also finds heterogeneity across sectors and policy instruments. The association between climate policies and green projects is particularly strong in energy and manufacturing, and when the composition of the recipient's climate portfolio is tilted towards binding policies (e.g., taxes and regulation) and expenditure measures. Finally, results point to policy spillovers, whereby larger climate policy portfolios in the source country are linked to higher green FDI outflows, but green subsidies can discourage them. This, in turn, implies that subsidies could hamper efforts to deploy low-carbon technologies across countries.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了气候政策作为催化剂，通过外国直接投资（FDI）促进低碳技术部署的作用。利用详细的跨境项目级信息，识别出“绿色”FDI，并发现活跃气候政策数量越多，绿色FDI流入量越高。重要的是，气候政策与非绿色FDI流入的减少并无关联。本文还发现不同部门和政策工具之间存在异质性。气候政策与绿色项目之间的关联在能源和制造业领域更为显著，且当接收国的气候政策组合偏向于约束性政策（税收和法规）及支出措施时，这种关联更强。最后，结果揭示了政策溢出效应，即来源国更庞大的气候政策组合与更高的绿色FDI流出相关联。此外，来源国更庞大的气候政策组合能放大目的地国气候政策作为绿色FDI催化剂的角色。

title: A Quantitative Analysis of Multidimensional Changes in Unemployment Insurance Policies
title_zh: 失业保险政策多维变化的定量分析
title_primary: 失业保险政策多维变化的定量分析
title_secondary: A Quantitative Analysis of Multidimensional Changes in Unemployment Insurance Policies
authors: Lei Fang, Jun Nie, Z. Xie
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The US government has historically expanded unemployment insurance (UI) during economic downturns along three policy dimensions: benefit amount, duration, and eligibility. We study how these elements affect the labor market, focusing in particular on the interaction among them. Specifically, we quantify the impact of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act UI package, which combined all three during the COVID-19 pandemic. The package raised average unemployment rate by 1.05 percentage points during April–December 2020. Two-thirds of this effect resulted from amplification by economic shutdown policies and COVID-19 infection risk. Decomposing the CARES Act UI package reveals that interactions between the three policy dimensions accounted for one-fourth of the total effect, highlighting that policy components do not operate in isolation.
abstract_zh: 美国政府历史上在经济衰退期间沿三个政策维度扩展失业保险（UI）：福利金额、期限和资格条件。我们研究这些要素如何影响劳动力市场，尤其关注它们之间的相互作用。具体而言，我们量化了《冠状病毒援助、救济和经济安全（CARES）法案》中的失业保险方案的影响，该方案在COVID-19疫情期间综合了这三个维度。该方案使2020年4月至12月的平均失业率上升了1.05个百分点。这一影响的三分之二源于经济封锁政策和COVID-19感染风险的放大效应。对CARES法案失业保险方案的分解显示，三个政策维度之间的相互作用占总效应的四分之一，凸显了政策组成部分并非孤立运作。

title: DP153 Budget Deficits, Interest Rates and the Incentive Effects of Income Tax Cuts
title_zh: 预算赤字、利率与所得税削减的激励效应
title_primary: 预算赤字、利率与所得税削减的激励效应
title_secondary: DP153 Budget Deficits, Interest Rates and the Incentive Effects of Income Tax Cuts
authors: Advisory Board, Charles Bean, Sweder van Wijnbergen, Angus Foulis, Jonathon Hazell 等
official: 官方在线 1987-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the effects of tax cuts in a multi-country world where both labour supply and capital formation are endogenous and taxes are distortionary. We highlight four channels through which tax cuts affect interest rates and the economy in general: (i) an increase in the supply of government debt; (ii) increased tax revenues, through increased economic activity; (iii) increased savings, through an increase in the post-tax return on savings; (iv) increased investment, through an increase in the marginal product of capital. The increase in the marginal product of capital may be related to the tax change either directly, in the case of capital taxation, or indirectly, through changes in future factor prices triggered by the tax changes. The indirect channel is important in the case of labour taxes. Tax cuts do not necessarily lead to a rise in interest rates in either the short or the long term. Welfare both at home and abroad may either increase or decrease as a result of the tax cuts; no general statement can be made without explicitly identifying which distortionary taxes are being changed. Even then ambiguities can arise, but we are able, in our analysis of adjustment dynamics, to trace the response of the term structure of real interest rates to the tax reform in different cases.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在多国世界中，劳动供给与资本形成均为内生且税收具有扭曲性时，减税的影响。我们强调了减税影响利率及整体经济的四个渠道：（i）政府债务供给的增加；（ii）通过经济活动增强带来的税收收入增加；（iii）通过储蓄税后回报率上升导致的储蓄增加；（iv）通过资本边际产品增加引发的投资增长。资本边际产品的增加可能与税收变动直接相关（如资本税情形），或间接相关（如通过税收变动引发的未来要素价格变化）。在劳动税情形下，间接渠道尤为重要。减税并不必然导致短期或长期利率上升。减税对国内外福利的影响可能上升也可能下降；若不明确识别所变动的具体扭曲性税收，则无法作出一般性论断。即便如此，仍可能存在模糊性，但在调整动态分析中，我们能够追溯不同情形下税收改革对实际利率期限结构的响应。

title: Do Health Insurers Matter for Health Outcomes? Evidence from a Large Natural Experiment in Colombia
title_zh: 健康保险公司对健康结果有影响吗？来自哥伦比亚一项大型自然实验的证据
title_primary: 健康保险公司对健康结果有影响吗？来自哥伦比亚一项大型自然实验的证据
title_secondary: Do Health Insurers Matter for Health Outcomes? Evidence from a Large Natural Experiment in Colombia
authors: Giancarlo Buitrago, Paul Rodríguez-Lesmes, Natalia Serna, Marcos Vera-Hernández
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While the relationship between health insurance coverage and health outcomes has been extensively studied, there is limited evidence on which specific features of insurance matter. We address this gap by leveraging the abrupt termination of Colombia’s largest health insurer and examining the spillover effects on patients who were not enrolled with the terminated insurer. The termination caused a 10% decrease in the breadth of provider networks among incumbent insurers and a 20% increase in mortality rates. We show two mechanisms drove the change in mortality: increased congestion stemming from the surge of enrollees at incumbent insurers and reduced provider network breadth. Insurers narrowed their networks by excluding higher-quality providers that served sicker, more expensive patients, whoin turn died at much higher rates than their counterparts. Findings suggest insurers play a key role in patient health through their provider networks.
abstract_zh: 尽管健康保险覆盖与健康结果之间的关系已被广泛研究，但关于保险具体特征如何影响健康结果的证据仍然有限。我们利用哥伦比亚最大健康保险公司的突然终止，考察其对未参保于该终止保险公司的患者产生的溢出效应，从而填补这一研究空白。该保险公司的终止导致现有保险公司的医疗服务提供者网络广度下降10%，死亡率上升20%。我们揭示了驱动死亡率变化的两种机制：因参保者涌入现有保险公司而导致的拥堵加剧，以及医疗服务提供者网络广度的缩减。保险公司通过排除那些服务于病情更重、医疗费用更高患者的优质医疗服务提供者来收窄其网络，而这些患者的死亡率远高于其他患者。研究结果表明，保险公司通过其医疗服务提供者网络在患者健康中发挥着关键作用。

title: Rebuilding the world order: Two strategies for a fragmented world
title_zh: 重建世界秩序：碎片化世界的两种策略
title_primary: 重建世界秩序：碎片化世界的两种策略
title_secondary: Rebuilding the world order: Two strategies for a fragmented world
authors: Dennis Snower
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As the postwar international order fragments and universal agreement becomes increasingly elusive, policymakers face a pressing question: what form of cooperation can replace the postwar hegemon-led, rules-based system? This column examines two complementary answers. Mark Carney argues that coalitions of middle powers can preserve stability, resilience, and strategic autonomy in an era of great-power rivalry. The author of this column proposes a broader architecture of pivotal power coalitions organised around human flourishing, policy alignment, and polycentric governance. Their dialogue illuminates one of the defining policy challenges of our time: how to combine geopolitical realism with effective collective action. Together, these approaches offer a practical roadmap for building a more resilient, cooperative, and problem-solving world order.
abstract_zh: 随着战后国际秩序碎片化，普遍共识愈发难以达成，政策制定者面临一个紧迫问题：何种合作形式能够取代战后由霸权主导、基于规则的国际体系？本专栏探讨了两种互补的答案。马克·卡尼认为，中等强国联盟可以在大国竞争时代维护稳定、韧性与战略自主。本专栏作者则提出一个更宏大的架构，即围绕人类繁荣、政策趋同与多中心治理构建关键力量联盟。两者的对话揭示了当代最具挑战性的政策议题之一：如何将地缘政治现实主义与有效的集体行动相结合。这些路径共同为构建更具韧性、更富合作精神且能有效解决问题的世界秩序提供了切实可行的路线图。

title: Can Facebook Ads Prevent Malaria? Two Field Experiments in India
title_zh: Facebook广告能否预防疟疾？印度两项实地实验
title_primary: Facebook广告能否预防疟疾？印度两项实地实验
title_secondary: Can Facebook Ads Prevent Malaria? Two Field Experiments in India
authors: Donati, Dante, Rao, Nandan, Orozco-Olvera, Victor, Boudet, Ana Maria Muñoz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study evaluates a nationwide malaria prevention campaign delivered through social media in India using a district-level cluster-randomized controlled trial. We combine two survey samples(N = 8,253) with administrative health records to assess effects on offline malaria-related behaviors and health outcomes. In the survey data, average treatment effects on protective behaviors, care-seeking intentions, and self-reported malaria incidence were small and insignificant. Administrative data similarly showed no detectable effect on overall recorded incidence. Post-hoc heterogeneity analysis, however, suggests that detectable effects were concentrated among households with higher socioeconomic status (SES) and in urban areas: for higher-SES households, bednet use increased during the campaign and self-reported malaria incidence declined afterward. In administrative records, monthly malaria incidence in urban areas fell by 6.2 cases per million people, a 33% decline relative to the pre-treatment rate. By contrast, estimates for lower-SES households and rural areas, which face higher malaria risk, were small and insignificant. In a second individual-level feed experiment (N = 1,542) that made ad delivery and exposure more comparable across SES groups, the ads increased bednet use and timely treatment-seeking intentions, with no detectable differences by SES. These patterns are consistent with delivery frictions contributing to the campaign
abstract_zh: 本研究通过一项以地区为集群的随机对照试验，评估了印度通过社交媒体开展的一项全国性疟疾预防运动。我们将两个调查样本（N = 8,253）与行政健康记录相结合，以评估其对线下疟疾相关行为和健康结果的影响。在调查数据中，对保护行为、就医意向及自我报告的疟疾发病率，平均处理效应较小且不显著。行政数据同样未显示对总体记录发病率有可检测的影响。然而，事后异质性分析表明，可检测的效应集中在社会经济地位（SES）较高及城市地区的家庭中：对于高SES家庭，蚊帐使用率在运动期间有所增加，而自我报告的疟疾发病率在之后有所下降。在行政记录中，城市地区的月度疟疾发病率每百万人下降了6.2例，相对于处理前水平下降了33%。相比之下，对于面临更高疟疾风险的低SES家庭和农村地区，估计效应较小且不显著。在第二个个体层面的信息流实验中（N = 1,542），该实验使不同SES群体间的广告投放和曝光更具可比性，广告增加了蚊帐使用和及时就医意向，且未发现按SES分组的可检测差异。这些模式与投放摩擦对运动效果的影响相一致。

title: Physician Learning and Forgetting: Evidence from the US Military
title_zh: 医师学习与遗忘：来自美国军方的证据
title_primary: 医师学习与遗忘：来自美国军方的证据
title_secondary: Physician Learning and Forgetting: Evidence from the US Military
authors: Trevor Fitzgerald, Atul Gupta, Stephen D. Schwab
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Physicians in the U.S. military health care system are quasi-randomly assigned to combat deployments, leading to gaps of varying durations in their clinical practice. We leverage this unique setting to provide novel causal evidence on skill depreciation (forgetting) and learning-by-doing among physicians. We find robust evidence that readmission rates increase by 48% in the first two months after a surgeon returns from a deployment. However, surgeons return to baseline performance within 6 months of resuming practice. In contrast, obstetricians maintain elevated cesarean section rates for up to 9 months, implying a deeper change in clinical judgment. Finally, we interpret these patterns through the lens of a learning model and estimate learning-by-doing rates for surgeons and obstetricians. A doubling of recent procedure volume reduces readmission and C-section rates by 17% and 11% for surgeons and obstetricians, respectively.
abstract_zh: 美国军事医疗体系中的医生被准随机分配至战斗部署任务，导致其临床实践出现不同时长的中断。我们利用这一独特情境，为医生技能折旧（遗忘）与干中学效应提供了新颖的因果证据。研究发现，外科医生从部署返回后的前两个月内，患者再入院率显著上升48%。然而，在恢复临床实践6个月内，其诊疗水平即可回归基线。相比之下，产科医生的剖宫产率在长达9个月期间持续处于高位，这暗示其临床判断发生了更深层的改变。最后，我们通过学习模型框架对这些模式进行解读，并估算了外科医生与产科医生的干中学速率：近期手术量每翻一番，外科医生的再入院率与产科医生的剖宫产率将分别降低17%与11%。

title: The Effects of Competition in the Retail Gasoline Industry
title_zh: 零售汽油行业竞争的影响
title_primary: 零售汽油行业竞争的影响
title_secondary: The Effects of Competition in the Retail Gasoline Industry
authors: Reid Taylor, Erich Muehlegger
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the effect of competition on incumbent firm pricing by using high frequency price data and the precise geographic location for all gas stations in California. Using an event study design, we find that the entry of a new station is associated with a 2.5 cent decrease in prices at incumbent stores, which equates to a 7% reduction in estimated retail markups. The effects are immediate, persistent, and show no sign of deterrence or limit pricing behavior. In contrast, nearby exit results in precisely estimated null effects on prices with no evidence of predatory pricing in the lead up to the station departure. The results are consistent across all fuel blends and dissipate with station distance. Finally, we explore the asymmetric effects, showing that the difference cannot be attributed to difference in branding, proximity to highway, or data quality idiosyncrasies, although we find suggestive evidence that exit tends to happen in more competitive markets and amongst less heavily trafficked stations.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高频价格数据和加利福尼亚州所有加油站的精确地理位置，估算了竞争对现有企业定价的影响。通过事件研究设计，我们发现新加油站的进入导致现有门店价格下降2.5美分，相当于零售加价幅度减少7%。这种影响是即时且持久的，没有表现出任何威慑或限制性定价行为的迹象。相比之下，附近加油站的退出对价格产生了精确估计的零效应，且在退出前未发现掠夺性定价的证据。所有燃料混合物的结果均一致，并随距离增加而减弱。最后，我们探讨了非对称效应，表明这种差异不能归因于品牌差异、高速公路邻近性或数据质量特性，尽管我们发现了暗示性证据，即退出往往发生在竞争更激烈的市场以及交通流量较少的加油站中。

title: Hedging interest rate risk when it matters: Evidence from Italian banks
title_zh: 关键时期的利率风险对冲：来自意大利银行的证据
title_primary: 关键时期的利率风险对冲：来自意大利银行的证据
title_secondary: Hedging interest rate risk when it matters: Evidence from Italian banks
authors: Michele Leonardo Bianchi, Dario Ruzzi, Anatoli Segura
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Valuation losses can build quickly in response to higher interest rates, as demonstrated by the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank. This column shows that Italian banks do hedge against interest rate risk and, crucially, increase hedging when rates rise. This suggests banks actively adjust hedging intensity through derivatives, consistent with a state-dependent model of risk management. Institutions with lower capital ratios, a larger share of wholesale funding, and a smaller deposit base hedge more aggressively. These findings highlight the importance of considering derivative exposure in stress-testing frameworks, as derivatives are a key channel through which banks absorb shocks.
abstract_zh: 利率上升可能导致估值损失迅速累积，硅谷银行的倒闭便印证了这一点。本文研究表明，意大利银行确实会对冲利率风险，且关键的是，当利率上升时，它们会加大对冲力度。这表明银行通过衍生品主动调整对冲强度，这与风险管理的状态依存模型相符。资本充足率较低、批发融资占比更高、存款基础较小的机构，其对冲行为更为激进。这些发现凸显了在压力测试框架中考虑衍生品敞口的重要性，因为衍生品是银行吸收冲击的关键渠道。

title: Corporate Green Pledges
title_zh: 企业绿色承诺
title_primary: 企业绿色承诺
title_secondary: Corporate Green Pledges
authors: Michael Bauer, Daniel Huber, Eric Offner, Ole Wilms
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize. (JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56)
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们通过利用大语言模型对新闻文章进行分类并结合人工验证，构建了一个包含美国上市公司时间戳企业脱碳承诺（绿色承诺）的新数据集。无论行业内部还是跨行业，发布绿色承诺的企业通常规模更大且碳排放强度更高。绿色承诺显著推高了股票价格，这与碳溢价的降低相一致，并预示着未来碳排放量和排放强度的大幅下降。这些效应在棕色行业的企业中最为显著。因此，绿色承诺具有可信度，向投资者传递了相关的新信息，并为脱碳提供了有意义的财务激励。（JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56）

title: 地方财政压力、信贷干预与银行风险承担
title_zh: 地方财政压力、信贷干预与银行风险承担
title_primary: 地方财政压力、信贷干预与银行风险承担
authors: 刘贯春, 柳杭娟, 陈肖雄, 何枫
official: 官方发布 2026-07-05 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 厘清财政金融互动逻辑是构建财政金融协同联动机制的重要基础，更是经济高质量发展的坚实保障。本文通过构建包含地方政府、商业银行与代表性企业的三期动态博弈模型，并结合基于房地产限购政策的多时点双重差分估计，系统考察了地方财政压力如何影响区域性商业银行风险承担水平。理论分析表明，为应对财政压力冲击，地方政府的信贷规模干预弱化了商业银行对借款企业的事前筛选强度，导致更多信贷资源流向了高风险企业，由此推升了银行风险承担水平。随后的计量检验结果支持了上述理论推断，证实了地方财政压力所导致的信贷规模干预是核心作用渠道，并排除了银行事后监督强度下降、房地产贷款减少等多种替代性解释。异质性分析显示，地方财政压力的银行风险承担效应在政策冲击强度大和政府干预能力强的地区以及资本充足率高的商业银行更为凸显。本文强调，地方政府对区域性商业银行的信贷干预在助力实体经济发展的同时，还会推升银行风险承担水平，这对于“稳增长”和“防风险”双重目标的实现具有重要政策启示。

title: The Potential Market for Care in East Asia and Pacific
title_zh: 东亚及太平洋地区照护服务的潜在市场
title_primary: 东亚及太平洋地区照护服务的潜在市场
title_secondary: The Potential Market for Care in East Asia and Pacific
authors: Esham, Nadia, Halim, Daniel, Mattoo, Aaditya
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Markets and public institutions must anticipate evolving care demand driven by East Asia and the Pacific’s exceptionally rapid demographic transition. To this end, this paper develops the Care Simulation Model, a demographic model that estimates gaps in childcare and eldercare needs. By integrating publicly available demographic data, the model captures both care needs and the availability of family caregivers across life cycles and cohorts, allowing the assessment of how demographic shifts may change reliance on family-based care. The paper quantifies unmet family care needs and translates them into estimates of potential market size, defined as the share of households likely to require care services outside the family and the corresponding potential employment creation in childcare and eldercare. By 2030, the childcare needs of an estimated 25 percent of households and the eldercare needs of 7 percent of households in ASEAN-5 countries may not be met within the family. After accounting for family availability and current care employment, the unmet need across 21 countries in East Asia and the Pacific translates into a potential gap of 19.9 million jobs in childcare and 34.1 million jobs in eldercare. The model offers a transparent, cross-country framework to inform care policy, workforce planning, and investment strategies.
abstract_zh: 市场和公共机构必须应对东亚及太平洋地区异常快速的人口转型所驱动的不断变化的照护需求。为此，本文开发了照护模拟模型，这是一种估算儿童照护和老年人照护需求缺口的人口模型。通过整合公开可得的人口数据，该模型捕捉了生命周期和队列中的照护需求及家庭照护者的可得性，从而评估人口结构变化如何改变对家庭照护的依赖。本文量化了未满足的家庭照护需求，并将其转化为潜在市场规模估计，定义为可能需要家庭外照护服务的家庭比例，以及儿童照护和老年人照护中相应的潜在就业创造。到2030年，东盟五国中约25%家庭的儿童照护需求和7%家庭的老年人照护需求可能无法在家庭内部得到满足。在考虑家庭可得性和当前照护就业后，东亚及太平洋地区21个国家的未满足需求转化为儿童照护领域1990万个潜在就业缺口和老年人照护领域3410万个潜在就业缺口。该模型提供了一个透明的跨国框架，为照护政策、劳动力规划和投资策略提供信息。

authors: Anne Lundgaard Hansen

abstract: This paper proposes a validation framework for LLM-generated measurements when reliable benchmarks are unavailable. Validity is established by testing whether an LLM can reconstruct passages from annotated labels while maintaining semantic consistency with the original text. The framework avoids circular reasoning by establishing testable prerequisite properties that must be met for a validation to be considered successful. Application to news article data demonstrates that the framework serves as a practical alternative to human benchmarking, which offers advantages in objectivity, scalability, and cost-effectiveness while identifying cases where LLMs capture economic meaning that human evaluators miss.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在缺乏可靠基准时验证大语言模型生成测量指标的框架。该框架通过检验大语言模型能否在保持与原文语义一致性的前提下，根据标注标签重建文本段落来确立有效性。通过建立验证成功必须满足的可检验前提属性，该框架避免了循环论证。对新闻文章数据的应用表明，该框架可作为人工基准测试的实用替代方案，在客观性、可扩展性和成本效益方面具有优势，同时能够识别出大语言模型捕捉到人类评估者遗漏的经济含义的案例。

title: Characterizing the ELS values with fixed-population invariance axioms
title_zh: 固定人口不变性公理下的ELS值特征刻画
title_primary: 固定人口不变性公理下的ELS值特征刻画
title_secondary: Characterizing the ELS values with fixed-population invariance axioms
authors: Yukihiko Funaki, Yukio Koriyama, Satoshi Nakada, Yuki Tamura
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study efficient, linear, and symmetric (ELS) values, a central family of allocation rules for cooperative games with transferable-utility (TU-games) that includes the Shapley value, the CIS value, and the ENSC value. We first show that every ELS value can be written as the Shapley value of a suitably transformed TU-game. We then introduce three types of invariance axioms for fixed player populations. The first type consists of composition axioms, and the second type is active-player consistency. Each of these two types yields a characterization of a subclass of the ELS values that contains the family of least-square values. Finally, the third type is nullified-game consistency: we define three such axioms, and each axiom yields a characterization of one of the Shapley, CIS, and ENSC values.
abstract_zh: 我们研究高效、线性且对称（ELS）值，这是可转移效用合作博弈（TU博弈）中一类核心的分配规则，包括Shapley值、CIS值和ENSC值。我们首先证明，每个ELS值都可以表示为适当变换后的TU博弈的Shapley值。接着，我们针对固定玩家群体引入三类不变性公理。第一类由组合公理组成，第二类是活跃玩家一致性。这两类中的每一类都刻画了ELS值的一个子类，该子类包含最小二乘值族。最后，第三类是无效化博弈一致性：我们定义了三个此类公理，每个公理分别刻画了Shapley值、CIS值和ENSC值中的一个。

title: Reserve Requirement Ratio and Capital Flows: A Regime-Switching DSGE Estimation for China
title_zh: 存款准备金率与资本流动：基于中国体制转换DSGE模型的估计
title_primary: 存款准备金率与资本流动：基于中国体制转换DSGE模型的估计
title_secondary: Reserve Requirement Ratio and Capital Flows: A Regime-Switching DSGE Estimation for China
authors: Ruopu Hu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We construct and estimate a small open economy DSGE model featuring a regime-switching reserve requirement (RR) ratio rule within a banking sector that has access to foreign assets. The model incorporates key financial characteristics of the Chinese economy and examines the implications of changes in the RR-ratio. Estimation results reveal that the RR-ratio follows a feedback rule with a regime-dependent coefficient on net foreign lending during two distinct phases between 2006 and 2017. The state-contingent rule is temporarily suspended during the Global Financial Crisis, but is reactivated in the post-crisis period amid recovered capital inflows. On the one hand, the RR-ratio has almost negligible real effects on output and inflation; but on the other hand, it proves effective as a macroprudential instrument by mitigating financial instability through a reduced risk of self-fulfilling bank runs by about 25%.
abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个小型开放经济DSGE模型，该模型在拥有外国资产的银行部门中引入了具有体制转换特征的法定存款准备金率规则。模型纳入了中国经济的核心金融特征，并考察了法定存款准备金率变动的经济影响。估计结果显示，在2006年至2017年间的两个不同阶段，法定存款准备金率遵循一个反馈规则，该规则对净外国贷款的系数具有体制依赖性。这一状态依存的规则在全球金融危机期间被暂时中止，但在危机后随着资本流入恢复而重新激活。一方面，法定存款准备金率对产出和通胀的实际影响几乎可以忽略不计；但另一方面，它作为宏观审慎工具被证明是有效的，通过将自我实现的银行挤兑风险降低约25%，从而缓解了金融不稳定。

title: Holding up Green Energy: Counterparty Risk in the Indian Solar Power Market
title_zh: 支撑绿色能源：印度太阳能市场中的交易对手风险
title_primary: 支撑绿色能源：印度太阳能市场中的交易对手风险
title_secondary: Holding up Green Energy: Counterparty Risk in the Indian Solar Power Market
authors: Nicholas Ryan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies how the risk of hold‐up affects procurement. I use data on the universe of solar power auctions in India. The Indian context allows clean estimates of counterparty risk, because solar plants set up in the same states, by the same firms, are procured in auctions intermediated by either risky states themselves or the trusted central government. I find that the counterparty risk of an average state increases solar prices by 10%. This risk premium sharply reduces investment, because demand for green energy is elastic. Contract intermediation by the central government eliminates the counterparty risk premium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了敲竹杠风险如何影响采购。我利用印度太阳能电力拍卖的全面数据进行分析。印度的情况使得对交易对手风险的估计变得清晰，因为同一企业在同一州建立的太阳能电站，其拍卖由风险较高的州政府或信誉良好的中央政府中介进行。我发现，平均州的交易对手风险使太阳能价格上升了10%。这一风险溢价显著减少了投资，因为绿色能源需求具有弹性。中央政府的中介合同消除了交易对手风险溢价。

title: Manufacturing Sentiment: Forecasting Industrial Production With Text Analysis
title_zh: 制造业情绪：基于文本分析的工业生产预测
title_primary: 制造业情绪：基于文本分析的工业生产预测
title_secondary: Manufacturing Sentiment: Forecasting Industrial Production With Text Analysis
authors: Tomaz Cajner, Leland D. Crane, Christopher Kurz, Norman Morin, Paul E. Soto 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper leverages free‐form textual responses from a key manufacturing survey to create sentiment indexes that mirror categorical measures from the same survey and also contain predictive content—both in and out‐of‐sample—for manufacturing output. We use textual data from the Institute for Supply Management to compare sentiment metrics based on dictionary and deep learning natural language processing methods. The best performing sentiment measures classify comments based on fine‐tuned deep learning models. To add interpretability, we apply Shapley decompositions to show that a relatively small number of words—associated with very positive and very negative sentiment—account for much of the variation in the aggregate sentiment index.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一项关键制造业调查中的自由文本回复，构建了反映同一调查中分类指标的情绪指数，并包含对制造业产出的预测内容——无论是样本内还是样本外。我们使用供应管理研究所的文本数据，比较基于词典和深度学习自然语言处理方法的情感指标。表现最佳的情感度量基于微调深度学习模型对评论进行分类。为增强可解释性，我们应用Shapley分解，表明相对较少的词汇——与非常积极和非常消极情绪相关——解释了总体情绪指数的大部分变动。

title: Chinese Export Gains, EU Export Losses, and Russian Import Reorientation after the 2022 Sanctions
title_zh: 2022年制裁后中国出口增长、欧盟出口损失与俄罗斯进口转向
title_primary: 2022年制裁后中国出口增长、欧盟出口损失与俄罗斯进口转向
title_secondary: Chinese Export Gains, EU Export Losses, and Russian Import Reorientation after the 2022 Sanctions
authors: Sjöholm, Fredrik
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how Russian imports were reoriented after the 2022 sanctions. Using annual bilateral trade data at the product level, it asks whether direct Chinese export gains to Russia were concentrated in the same product lines in which EU exports to Russia declined. It also studies rerouting through Hong Kong, Armenia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Türkiye. The results point to substantial post-2022 import reorientation in Russia. Direct Chinese export gains are larger in product lines where Russia had depended more heavily on EU suppliers before the sanctions. Including transit-linked flows strengthens this relationship and points to broader rerouting through intermediary economies in those same product lines. In sanction-relevant goods, direct Chinese gains offset only part of the EU shortfall, while intermediary-country channels account for a substantial additional share. On the EU side, product-level evidence also suggests that some of the lost Russian market was absorbed through higher exports of the same products to other non-transit destinations. The evidence is therefore consistent with partial direct substitution by China, broader rerouting through intermediary economies, and partial outward redirection by EU exporters, not full replacement of lost EU exports.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2022年制裁后俄罗斯进口如何实现重新定向。利用产品层面的年度双边贸易数据，研究聚焦于中国对俄直接出口增长是否集中于欧盟对俄出口下降的同类产品线，并探讨了经由香港、亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和土耳其的转运路径。结果表明，2022年后俄罗斯进口出现了显著重新定向。在制裁前俄罗斯更依赖欧盟供应商的产品线上，中国直接出口增长更为显著。纳入转运关联流量后，这一关系得到强化，表明同类产品线通过中间经济体的转运范围更广。在制裁相关商品中，中国直接出口增长仅部分弥补了欧盟供应缺口，而中间经济体渠道则贡献了相当可观的额外份额。从欧盟方面看，产品层面证据亦表明，部分失去的俄罗斯市场份额被同一产品对其他非转运目的地的出口增长所吸收。因此，证据支持中国部分直接替代、通过中间经济体的广泛转运以及欧盟出口商的部分向外转向，而非对欧盟流失出口的完全替代。

title: Reassessing the Cross‐Sectional Fiscal Multiplier: Evidence From U.S. Defense Procurement, 1966–2019
title_zh: 重新评估横截面财政乘数：来自1966-2019年美国国防采购的证据
title_primary: 重新评估横截面财政乘数：来自1966-2019年美国国防采购的证据
title_secondary: Reassessing the Cross‐Sectional Fiscal Multiplier: Evidence From U.S. Defense Procurement, 1966–2019
authors: Gianluca Pallante
official: 官方在线 2026-05-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper revisits the empirical analysis of Nakamura and Steinsson (2014). I reconstructed and extended the original dataset to cover the period 1966–2019, harmonizing two major sources of data: the Defense Contract Action Data System (DCADS) and USAspending.gov. I discuss how to aggregate these contract‐level data to better capture spending more directly tied to domestic stimulus. Estimated multipliers are slightly lower in narrow replications but increase when incorporating later fiscal episodes. I also assess the validity and stability of cross‐sectional estimates. While some heterogeneity exists, dispersion in state‐level responses remains within reasonable boundaries, especially when accounting for dynamic persistence.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nakamura与Steinsson（2014）的实证分析。我重构并扩展了原始数据集，将研究时段覆盖至1966-2019年，整合了两大主要数据来源：国防合同行动数据系统（DCADS）与USAspending.gov。我探讨了如何聚合这些合同级数据，以更精准地捕捉与国内刺激直接相关的支出。在狭义复制中，估计乘数略低，但纳入后期财政事件后有所上升。我还评估了横截面估计的有效性与稳定性。尽管存在一定异质性，但各州层面响应的离散程度仍处于合理范围内，尤其是在考虑动态持续性之后。

title: Gender and Racial Differences in Migration Behavior: Evidence from the Farm Exodus within and out of the U.S. South, 1900–1940
title_zh: 迁移行为中的性别与种族差异：来自1900–1940年美国南部农业人口外迁的证据
title_primary: 迁移行为中的性别与种族差异：来自1900–1940年美国南部农业人口外迁的证据
title_secondary: Gender and Racial Differences in Migration Behavior: Evidence from the Farm Exodus within and out of the U.S. South, 1900–1940
authors: Withrow, Jennifer
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using linked Census Tree records and archival sources, I explore the roles of race and gender in migrant selection and sorting during the exodus of single young women and men from U.S. Southern farms from 1900–1940. Female migration rates, influenced by changes in farm men’s marriageability, rose during the farm crisis of 1920–1940 and exceeded men’s by 1940. On- and off-farm discrimination by race and gender drove differences in migrant characteristics: out-of-South Black female migrants, but not within-South, were positively selected on education and family resources, while White women were positively selected across both destinations.
abstract_zh: 利用关联的人口普查树记录与档案资料，本文探究了1900-1940年间美国南部农场单身青年男女外迁过程中，种族与性别在移民选择与分类中的作用。受农场男性婚姻适龄性变化影响，女性迁移率在1920-1940年农业危机期间上升，并于1940年超过男性。种族与性别在农场内外遭遇的歧视导致移民特征差异：迁出南部的黑人女性移民（而非南部内部迁移者）在教育程度与家庭资源方面呈现正向选择，而白人女性在两个迁移目的地均呈现正向选择。

title: Gender inequality in urban British Africa: Evidence from Anglican marriage registers
title_zh: 英属非洲城市中的性别不平等：来自圣公会婚姻登记的证据
title_primary: 英属非洲城市中的性别不平等：来自圣公会婚姻登记的证据
title_secondary: Gender inequality in urban British Africa: Evidence from Anglican marriage registers
authors: Felix Meier zu Selhausen, Jacob Weisdorf
official: 官方在线 2026-03-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the colonial origins and evolution of gender inequality in mission schooling and formal labour force participation across six cities in British colonial Africa, using marriage register data for some 30,000 Anglican brides and grooms well‐positioned to benefit from colonial educational and employment opportunities. The spouses’ signature literacy and occupational statistics reveal growing gender gaps during the early colonial period, both in access to mission schools and formal work. The gender gap in formal work was much more extensive than that in schooling, peaking in the 1930s but then rapidly declining again, helped by the Africanisation and feminisation of the British colonial public service towards decolonization. Women's alternatives to formal labour differed markedly across urban British Africa, with the majority of West African brides engaging in informal income‐generating activities, in contrast to their East African peers, who were primarily devoted to homemaking. We attribute these regional differences to women's greater economic agency in precolonial West Africa, which persisted despite the Victorian gender ideals promoted by missionaries.
abstract_zh: 我们利用约三万名英国殖民时期非洲六座城市中，处于殖民教育与就业机会有利地位的圣公会新郎新娘的婚姻登记数据，考察了传教士学校教育及正规劳动力参与中性别不平等的殖民起源与演变。配偶的签名识字率及职业统计揭示了殖民早期在进入传教士学校和正规工作方面性别差距的扩大。正规工作中的性别差距远大于教育领域，于1930年代达到顶峰，随后迅速缩小，这得益于去殖民化进程中英国殖民公共服务的非洲化与女性化。在英属非洲各城市，女性对正规劳动的选择存在显著差异，大多数西非新娘从事非正规创收活动，而东非新娘则主要致力于家务。我们将这些区域差异归因于前殖民时期西非女性更强的经济自主性，这种自主性在传教士推广的维多利亚时代性别理想下依然得以延续。

title: Potty Parity
title_primary: Potty Parity
authors: Setareh Farajollahzadeh, Ming Hu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-12-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We address the issues of unequal restroom access for women and LGBTQ+ individuals, known as the potty parity problem. We propose a utility model in which users consider gender identity, wait time, and safety concerns when choosing restrooms. We evaluate different layouts’ efficiency measured by the total utilities (as in the utilitarian principle) and assess their fairness using the measures of the minimum utility gain (as in the Rawlsian fairness) and the gap between maximum and minimum gains (as in the distributive fairness). When the population is sensitive to gender identity and safety concerns, although it may initially seem intuitive to assume that converting all restrooms to unisex facilities would be efficient and fair due to the pooling of servers and increased flexibility and perceived fairness due to all users standing in the same line, our findings demonstrate that this design can be neither efficient nor fair. In contrast, we show that converting some men’s restrooms to unisex can enhance both efficiency and fairness of access. This highlights that a moderate level of flexibility can outperform a fully flexible system. Moreover, conventional wisdom suggests that removing a restroom unit from the men’s room would negatively impact users from the men’s side. However, our analysis reveals a counterintuitive insight that such a change can lead to a Pareto improvement, benefiting all users involved. We also analytically explore additional benefits of unisex restrooms under different user behaviors and situations and present practically relevant numerical results to support our findings. This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grant RGPIN-2021-04295]. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.04075 .

title: Transition of sub-national fiscal multiplier across structural characteristics – evidence from Indian states
title_zh: 印度各邦财政乘数在结构性特征差异下的转变——来自印度各邦的证据
title_primary: 印度各邦财政乘数在结构性特征差异下的转变——来自印度各邦的证据
title_secondary: Transition of sub-national fiscal multiplier across structural characteristics – evidence from Indian states
authors: Mahima Gupta, Amlendu Dubey
official: 官方在线 2025-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this article, we study the transition of sub-national fiscal multipliers’ efficiency in normal times across the structural characteristics’ threshold levels in the Indian states. Using the recently developed Panel Structure Threshold Regression Model, we identify latent groups across the states contingent on their structural characteristics. Our findings suggest that for Indian states, capital outlay expenditure multipliers are higher than revenue and total spending multipliers. We identify financial inclusion as one of the important state-level fiscal multiplier determinants. Our results suggest that state public debt has negative implications for all the categories of fiscal multipliers and across all the latent groups. Based on our study, we argue for a sustainable policy-oriented targeting framework, which should include threshold levels for public debt accretion as a sub-target.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了印度各邦在常态时期，其结构性特征阈值水平下地方财政乘数效率的转变。利用近期发展的面板结构阈值回归模型，我们根据各邦的结构性特征识别出潜在群体。研究结果表明，对于印度各邦而言，资本支出乘数高于收入乘数和总支出乘数。我们识别出金融包容性是邦级财政乘数的一个重要决定因素。我们的结果显示，邦公共债务对所有类别的财政乘数以及所有潜在群体均产生负面影响。基于我们的研究，我们主张建立一个可持续的政策导向型目标框架，该框架应将公共债务累积的阈值水平作为子目标纳入其中。
